title: fix(agentic-os): keep the words around a path in a goal, ask or decision
body:
The path scrub I applied to all state-file free text ran to the end of the
line, so "Should I delete C:\tmp\cache or keep it?" reached Dave as "Should I
delete <path>" and the question lost its meaning (CodeRabbit finding on #200).
Free text now uses patterns that end a path at whitespace and keep a trailing
sentence mark; error messages keep the greedy scrub. A path with a space in it
can leave its tail visible, which is the chosen trade-off.

RED: the new spec showed the goal as "Move logs from <path>".
